name: viral-content-skills
description: Create and evaluate content engineered to spread and stick, using the STEPPS framework from Jonah Berger's "Contagious" and the SUCCESs framework from Chip & Dan Heath's "Made to Stick". Includes a creator skill that turns a brief into publish-ready copy and an evaluator skill that scores any draft 0-5 across 12 dimensions with quoted evidence.
